{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema/registry-item.json",
  "name": "producer-pipeline-flow",
  "type": "registry:block",
  "title": "Pipeline Flow",
  "description": "graph.json rendered by @xyflow/react inside a stock Card as a swimlane: lanes are the seat holders (the pipeline roster, plus Unassigned while any step has no holder), columns are the named stages as stock outline Badges across the top; one components.flow.base-node per step wrapped in the React Flow UI NodeStatusIndicator, its header the stock shadcn Item; a seat in the URL highlights that lane with stock Item and Badge variants; the pinned smoothstep edge, stock Controls and MiniMap; selecting a step opens a read-only shadcn Sheet whose facts (stage, holder with kind, tier and file or derived source) are stock Field label + value pairs.",
  "author": "Clossys",
  "dependencies": [
    "@xyflow/react"
  ],
  "registryDependencies": [
    "components.badge",
    "components.card",
    "components.field",
    "components.flow.base-node",
    "components.flow.canvas",
    "components.flow.edge",
    "components.flow.labeled-handle",
    "components.flow.node-status",
    "components.item",
    "components.sheet"
  ],
  "files": [
    {
      "path": "index.tsx",
      "type": "registry:component",
      "target": "studio/sections/producer-pipeline-flow/index.tsx"
    }
  ]
}

element.reason: SYSTEMS-IA D3(b) (owner: the overview shows who is doing what work, when; shadcn-compatible, no hand-rolling): the canvas becomes a swimlane, lanes the seat holders and columns the named stages (stock outline Badge stage headers as non-selectable nodes); the sheet adds the step's stage and holder (kind, tier, file or derived source) as stock Field rows; a ?seat=<id> highlights that lane with stock Item muted and Badge default variants. planner 2026-11-04 (SYSTEMS-IA).
